La Roche-Posay Effaclar Duo was an absolute game-changer for me. Out of nowhere, I developed painful cystic acne in my twenties, and after trying countless products with little to no success, I was feeling frustrated and discouraged. This product was recommended to me, and it ended up being the one thing that actually worked. Within a short period of time, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin. The deep, painful cystic breakouts that seemed impossible to get rid of became less frequent and eventually cleared up. Not only did it help treat existing blemishes, but it also seemed to prevent new ones from forming. Years later, I still keep Effaclar Duo on hand and use it whenever I feel a blemish starting to develop. It continues to work incredibly well and remains one of the few skincare products that has consistently delivered results for me. If you've struggled with stubborn acne and feel like you've tried everything, I can't recommend this product highly enough. It truly changed my skin—and my confidence.

I’ve been using the La Roche-Posay Effaclar Duo+ and I’m honestly really happy with the results. I have oily skin, so finding a product that helps my skin look more balanced without making it feel heavy has always been important to me. What I really like about this product is the lightweight feel. It fits easily into my skincare routine and doesn’t leave my skin feeling overly greasy. After using it consistently, I noticed my skin looked clearer, smoother, and more balanced overall. For me, the biggest difference has been how much more comfortable I feel with my skin throughout the day. I used to struggle with excess oil and the way my skin looked when it became shiny, and adding Effaclar Duo+ to my routine helped me so much. I also love that it’s easy to incorporate into a daily skincare routine without making things complicated. If you have oily or blemish-prone skin and are looking for something lightweight, I definitely think this is worth trying. This has become one of my favorite products in my skincare routine, and I would happily purchase it again.

I have sensitive, rosacea, prone skin-slight irritation at first, but it calms and clears my occasional breakouts. I love this product. The texture is light, almost not fragance/scent. Fast absorption, never clogging, and and keeps great cleanliness on my skin. Amazing value. Reliable, effective, and worth it.

I was really hopeful about the La Roche Posay Effaclar Duo+M treatment, especially since I struggle with persistent blackheads and the occasional stubborn whitehead. I bought it because it promised to target these exact issues with salicylic acid. I used it just as suggested. After cleansing my skin thoroughly, I applied a thin layer over the areas where I usually break out. I did this consistently every day. The cream itself feels lightweight and didn't irritate my sensitive skin which was a definite plus. It absorbed well and didn't leave any greasy residue. However, after couple weeks of use, I have to say I don’t notice a noticeable result. My blackheads look pretty much the same and while it might have helped with some minor spots, it didn't make a significant impact on my overall complexion or prevent new blemishes from forming. For me, the promised visible results just weren't there. Unfortunately it just didn't do much for me.
I’ve been using this every night and I’m already noticing a difference! My skin looks smoother, and I’ve had fewer breakouts.

avis.titre: Works great on recently popped pimples
avis.texte: Love this La Roche Posay brand. It's reliable, trustworthy, and effective. This is yet another great acne product from them. I had a pulsing white head on my chin that recently popped after using overnight hydrocolloid pimple patch on it. I didn't want it to scar or leave blemish so I used this cream on top and so far so good the next morning. It's much smaller and not as red. I will continue to use it throughout the week because I'm seeing good immediate results so far. However, I used a small amount on my nose for blackheads but I'm unsure of the results. Still see my pores with little dark brown fillings. I will continue using it though but not sure if the 8-hour result is working as effectively on my nose, we'll see. I have dry skin and it didn't irritate or leave redness so overall, I'm happy with it.
